title: Hom objects from the standard simplex and its boundary are the term and the matching object
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $K$ a simplicial object of $\mathrm{SR}(X)$, with matching objects $M_n(K)$, canonical morphisms $\mu_n:K_n\to M_n(K)$ (components $d_0,\dots,d_n$) and, for $n\geq1$, projections $\mathrm{pr}_i:M_n(K)\to K_{n-1}$ onto the $i$-th factor ($0\leq i\leq n$) [def-weil-pbc-semi-representable-object]. For $n\geq0$ let $\Delta[n]$ be the simplicial set with $\Delta[n]_m$ the set of order-preserving maps $\varphi:[m]\to[n]$ and $\Delta[n](\psi)(\varphi)=\varphi\circ\psi$, and let $\partial\Delta[n]\subseteq\Delta[n]$ be the simplicial subset whose $m$-simplices are the non-surjective $\varphi:[m]\to[n]$ (so $\partial\Delta[0]$ is empty). For $0\leq i\leq n$ let $\delta_i:[n-1]\to[n]$ be the injection omitting $i$, an $(n-1)$-simplex of $\partial\Delta[n]$. Then: (a) $\Delta[n]_m$ is finite and nonempty for all $m$ and $\Delta[n]$ has finitely many nondegenerate simplices (the injective $\varphi$), and $K_n$ with the family $(K(\varphi):K_n\to K_m)_{\varphi\in\Delta[n]_m}$ is $\operatorname{Hom}(\Delta[n],K)_0$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-hom-object]: this family is a $\Delta[n]$-family over $K_n$ and every $\Delta[n]$-family $(f_\varphi)$ over an object $W$ is $(K(\varphi)\circ f_{\mathrm{id}_{[n]}})_\varphi$ for the unique morphism $f_{\mathrm{id}_{[n]}}:W\to K_n$. (b) For $n\geq1$, $\partial\Delta[n]_m$ is finite and nonempty for all $m$ and $\partial\Delta[n]$ has finitely many nondegenerate simplices, and there is a unique isomorphism $\theta:\operatorname{Hom}(\partial\Delta[n],K)_0\to M_n(K)$ with $\mathrm{pr}_i\circ\theta=u_{\delta_i}$ for $0\leq i\leq n$, where $(u_s)$ is the universal $\partial\Delta[n]$-family. (c) For $n\geq1$, if $\rho:K_n\to\operatorname{Hom}(\partial\Delta[n],K)_0$ is the unique morphism with $u_\varphi\circ\rho=K(\varphi)$ for every simplex $\varphi$ of $\partial\Delta[n]$ (the restriction morphism along $\partial\Delta[n]\subseteq\Delta[n]$ under the identification (a)), then $\theta\circ\rho=\mu_n$.

source.place: Lemma 018V (lemma-cosk-shriek) for (b), (c), with the matching object (cosk_{n-1} sk_{n-1} K)_n written as the limit of Lemma 0186 (lemma-formula-limit) as in def-weil-pbc-semi-representable-object; Lemma 0177 (lemma-simplex-map) for (a); used in hypercovering.tex Lemma 01GM (lemma-one-more-simplex), proof, last paragraph ('By Simplicial, Lemma 018V this arrow is identified with K_n -> (cosk_{n-1} sk_{n-1} K)_n')
